newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cabinet confirms DPEF meeting on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Italy cabinet confirms DPEF meeting on Friday.

text.p: Italy's cabinet will meet at 0930 GMT on Friday to discuss the centre-left government's three-year economic strategy document (DPEF), an official statement said.

The plan, which lays out economic targets for 1998-2000, will be a crucial indicator of how the government intends to keep Italy within the criteria laid down for membership of Europe's planned single currency. Deputy prime minister Walter Veltroni has said the DPEF will be approved at Friday's meeting.
